integrity: The primary source was inspected at the definition of lambda-Steiner symmetrization, the definition of invariance, the flat-direction machinery, and Conjecture 7.2. The proof here is independent and all-dimensional: it derives a one-step central-symmetry criterion directly from the fiber formulas and then uses the countability of facets. The bundled checker is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem settles only the centrally symmetric subclass of the higher-dimensional invariant-body conjecture. It gives a qualitative countability obstruction and does not treat non-centrally-symmetric invariant candidates or random-process recurrence.
title: Central-symmetry obstruction for intermediate \(\lambda\)-Steiner invariance
